context: A police officer briefs on industrial-record keeping
purpose: Teach: 標本/返却/動き出し/没頭/書斎/切り捨て/開講/社名

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の標本管理、警察基準で確認しました。
lines.en: I've reviewed your sample management protocols. They meet police standards.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. Slight pause before confirming. No inflection that softens or hardens the statement—just clear procedural acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出版社からの本、返却処理、徹底中です。
lines.en: Understood. We're working through the publisher book returns with strict processing.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slightly forward-leaning in posture—eager to show compliance. Clean, steady pacing without rushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: プロジェクト、警察と歩調を合わせて動き出しましょう。
lines.en: Let's move forward with the project in step with the police department.
lines.style: Calm directive. Light weight on the opening word. Professional but not distant—the voice of someone used to collaboration. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 担当の没頭の様子、評価していただきました。
lines.en: Your team appreciated how focused our lead has been on this.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath professional register. A small exhale of relief—gratitude without overstatement. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 創設者の書斎にある古文書、保管基準、設けてください。
lines.en: For the historical documents in the founder's study, please establish storage standards.
lines.style: Methodical, clear. Weight on the key instruction word. No rush—the voice of someone who expects careful attention. Slight pause before 'please' to signal importance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 過去資料の切り捨て、慎重に判断します。
lines.en: We'll be careful about which historical materials we remove from the collection.
lines.style: Measured reassurance. Slight hesitation on the opening—not uncertainty, but thoughtfulness. Slower pace to underscore the weight of the decision. Quiet finish.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 共同講座、開講します。社名併記、お願いします。
lines.en: The joint course launches. Please include both institution names.
lines.style: Factual, slightly warming now—the voice shifting toward conclusion. Light emphasis on 'both' without being rigid. Clean, forward-facing delivery.
